verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic access is a fair question for an online administrative portal, which could expose an API or automation path, so the axis applies. The probes show no such path: the ANEF host serves only a ~3 KB JavaScript shell with every transaction behind an account, and the parent ministry site returns a Cloudflare 403 challenge to keyless agents. The pack contains no documentation of an API, CLI or CI integration.
